notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.17
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Retainer: Raphael, Sinhunter Cardinal (Carry)
[*]3v3 Map update: Shorter lanes, less jungle camps, repositioned towers, starting lvl 3 with 900g (experimental)
[*]Jungler items have been added
[*]Monsters now give more XP early game, allowing junglers to level quicker
[*]Monster health decreased, damage maintained. Goal is to make jungling more difficult for laners who have to leverage lost health to gold/xp gain
[*]Spawn times changed; buffs spawn slower, jungle camps spawn faster
[*]Vessels give more base Health; the goal is to reduce early TTK to make the laning phase more casual-friendly
[*]Various projectiles had their speed adjusted
[*]Towers can no longer be crit
[/list]

[h2]Visuals, Sound and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Heavily WIP: Game UI full update with new assets
[*]tower indicators have been made more visible
[*]many ability tooltips have been reworded
[*]fountain towers have been added (to replace you just randomly dying)
[/list]

[h2]Lobby[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various infrastructure improvements have been made, making it easier to identify problems
[*]A new messaging system has been implemented on the backend, making custom lobbies and gamesetups more responsive
[*]fixed an issue that could cause you to end up in a ghost lobby when spam clicking "create lobby"
[*]fixed an issue that could cause you to end up in two lobbies at the same time
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]fixed a client crash caused by badly formatted tooltips
[*]fixed a client crash when trying to assign target retainers only hotkey
[*]fixed automatically autoattacking allies (Lana)
[*]fixed synestra Q action queing issues
[*]fixed hammer of conviction active stopping your movement
[*]fixed various problems that could cause spells to not be removed from the client
[*]fixed score panel eating up mouse clicks and bringing up the debug view too easily
[*]fixed tick based abilities losing damage when a buff is extended
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.16
notes.content:
[h2]Visuals, Sound and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]shop UI updated
[*]settings UI reworked
[*]added a setting to show split damage numbers
[*]improved various tooltips
[*]improved ingame chat readability
[*]the game now automatically sets your UI scale setting when you change resolution/on first start
[*]you can now move the camera after a replay ends
[*]chat emotes are now bigger
[*]added vessel suggestion hightlight
[*]added vfx for apostles tome, windhoppers cane, belladonna gloves, coghammer, mitre of saints, nerumian mending beads, rallying crest

[*]added a setting to toggle target-retainers-only mode

[*]scaling nerfs on most offenders (eg. Vissra, Marzena, etc.)

[list]
[*]fixed doom lance mark duration

[*]fixed goliath gauntlets sometimes not working
[*]fixed waygates warping to wrong location
[*]fixed darkfire emitter tag on zildars necklace
[*]fixed diver helmet reducing your own damage to 0 while slow is active
[*]fixed some missing tooltips and icons
[*]fixed oppressive percussions vfx
[*]fixed voltez passive not triggering if target dies
[*]fixed passive item spells being castable
[*]fixed fired up proccing on minions
[*]fixed a rare server crash
[*]fixed the sticker menu not working while in lobby
[*]fixed seismic core and skinning knife not being unique
[*]fixed UI sound slider not properly working on ingame UI sounds
[*]fixed some pets having bugged minimap icons
[*]fixed not being able to ping pingables with the basic ping key
[*]fixed a crash when skipping in replays
[*]fixed material overrides like timedialator not working properly on some characters
[*]fixed icons getting stuck when scrolling in the item description
[*]fixed a bug that would cause you to randomly switch your attack target when "attack nearby enemies" was turned on
[*]fixed rudra f hitting invisible enemies
[*]fixed diver helmet vfx
[*]fixed helentris r not showing range on hover
[*]fixed krieg r not showing range on hover
[*]fixed kalgaran chain axe vfx stuck bug
[*]fixed belladonna gloves not proccing on entom aa
[*]fixed skinning knife missing unique name
[*]fixed rallying crest proccing on spells that applied the buff
[*]fixed post game screen from last game still showing
[*]fixed new items missing their tags
[*]fixed helentris r vfx stopping abruptly
[*]fixed lobby and game UI volumes not being adjustable intependantly
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.15
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*]New 5v5 map layout is testable (select TEST 5v5 in map dropdown)
[*]New Vessel: Fralnir, Soul of the Hoarfrost Guardian [Battle Mage]
[*]New rewards from hydra and dragon: basic gem system, black shards have been retired
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Parts and Waystones have been added to round out recipes
[*]Shield Basher (Shield Damage)
[*]Skinning Knife (Jungling speed)
[*]Kalgaran Chain Axe (Mobility)
[*]Diver Helmet (Diving)
[*]Lamprey (Sustain)
[*]Wardruid's Mantle (Sustained Fighting)
[*]Hellhands (Waveclear and max Health Damage)
[*]Goliath Gauntlets (Sustain and Health Damage scaling)
[*]Nightcutter (Burst Damage)
[*]Seismic Core (Waveclear + CC)
[*]Rallying Crest (CC Support)
[*]Dawn and Dusk (Damage Support)
[*]Mitre of Saints (Damage Support)
[*]Apostles' Tome (Heal Support)
[*]Windhopper's Cane (Artillery)
[*]Belladonna Gloves (Damage over Time)
[*]Nerumian Mending Beads (Sustain)
[*]Telsamar Coghammer (Basic Attack affinity)
[*]Templar's Flail (Damage from Resource)
[*]Chains of the Taskmaster (Spellslinger)
[*]Dread Orb (Resource Damage Scaling)
[*]5H-RED-3R (Physical Caster Damage)
[*]Glitter Bomb (areal stealth reveal)
[/list]

[h2]Item Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Many Items have gotten their recipes and stat lines adjusted
[*]Severed Isles Impaler now stack Magic Resistance instead of Physical Power
[*]Stonewall Crown and Antimagic Headguard now grant their shield before dropping below 25% and before suffering the respective damage
[*]Embrace of the Forest now heals when being healed or shielded
[*]Branch of the World Tree now grants a shield based on spent resource
[*]Paindrinker now grants on kill via any damage and deals damage on Shimmer procc
[*]Master Magicians Mantle passive has been reverted to reduce cooldowns of spells on spell cast
[*]Hammer of Conviction is now manually activated
[*]Doom Lance now applies a mark separately from the slow, which gets used up to do the bonus damage
[*]Thuulian Ripdagger now reduces flat armor instead of percentage
[*]Hortax Circlet now deals damage around the user instead of the spell location and is increased against minions
[*]Juncture Band has a new passive granting delayed damage based on damage dealt to a target in a short amount of time
[*]Glacial Pauldrons attack speed reduction now scales with bonus resource
[*]Ring of the King's threshold is now based on Ethereal Power
[*]Pocket Singularity now shares cooldown with Telsamar Timedialator and puts the user in stasis
[*]Skull of Impending Doom can not be cancelled by the user anymore but grants them immunity to Crowd Control during the cast time
[*]Spikethorn Shoulderpads' damage reflection ramps up now
[*]Tolundir Helmet is now a starter item
[*]Wardancer's Boots' passive now grants attackspeed instead of movement speed
[*]Southern Gladius now deals bonus damage with basic attacks with a cooldown
[*]Prayer Beads now grant resource regeneration based on missing resource
[*]Barbarian Ornament now grants resource on auto attacks
[*]Soulfire Staff now grants resource on level up based on max resource
[*]Chaos Blade now burns resource on hit
[/list]

[h2]Visuals, Sound and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Xelv voice lines have been added
[*]tooltips now show "bonus" instead of ' for bonus value scalings
[*]some scroll vfx have been improved
[*]some spells now play a sounds when they start casting, not only when they finish (this will be improved for all spells over time)
[*]item stats now always show in a defined order
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]block rating no longer reduces onhit damage
[*]krieg passive now constantly lowers r cooldown over time at max stacks instead of instant reset
[*]parrying dagger stacks dont reset anymore
[*]uzai hook changes your direction towards the unit now
[*]hydra spells have been reworked to be more fair
[*]dragon is now harder to kite
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]fixed thundergod unique tag duplicate in tooltip
[*]fixed xelv passive not mentioning q being able to proc it
[*]fixed shizu passive proccing off stuff other than shizu basic attacks
[*]fixed games permanently hanging if they get paused after a nexus has died
[*]fixed morning star vfx
[*]fixed neri f projectile icon missing
[*]fixed startetr items counting as basic attacks instead of on hit
[*]fixed lodwig w recast not consuming when close to target
[*]fixed faceless carving not ticking on start
[*]fixed syn passive not mentioning missing health damage
[*]fixed chainbreaker not showing as active item
[*]fixed buildpath not showing correct amount of items in teaminventory (like obsidian shards in chaos stone)
[*]fixed synestra w reset not scaling with cdr
[*]fixed being able to unlock zoom in builds
[*]fixed xelv q not critting
[*]fixed shizu passive proccing on other onhit triggers than shizu basic attack
[*]fixed bloodstone buff tooltip and icon
[*]fixed some invalid damage classes on various effects
[*]fixed expected ticks on short buffs sometimes not applying the last tick
[/list]

[h2]Lobby fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]profanity will no longer be allowed in player names and lobby titles
[*]fixed an issue that could cause lobbies to become unstartable
[*]fixed pending lobby invites not being removed after a lobby is closed
[*]fixed lobby invites not properly showing a reason when they can't be accepted
[*]fixed position selection showing players from last game
[*]fixed position selection updates changing the role of all players on the team
[*]fixed time stamp problems with messages in lobbies
[*]fixed messages being replayed multiple times when joining a lobby
[*]fixed a situation where you could be disconnected from the lobby but not be moved back to login screen
[*]fixed an issue where someone declining an invite would cancel an active queue pop
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.14
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] talent update
[list]
[*] new talents have been added to all trees
[*] many of the rarely used talents have been reworked or replaced
[*] the trees have been re-layouted
[*] smaller and bigger changes were made to many existing talents to make them more useful or interesting
[/list]
[*] added lane/role intention system to the game setup
[list]
[*] click on a lane to indicate you want to go there
[*] select the role you intent do fullfill (defaults to your suggested retainer role)
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] dandra changes
[list]
  [*] passive now generates stacks when nearby allies take or deal damage
  [*] Charged Q will do increased healing/damage
  [*] W will reduce all cooldowns of the target ally
  [*] E grows further
  [*] E now only grows in a target direction
[/list]

[/list]
[h2]Visuals, UI, Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] added icons for character roles
[*] shutdowns are now announced in chat
[*] 6v6 lobbies can now be made by everyone
[*] removed buff display from minions
[*] scrolls now have their own openable category in the shop
[*] ability button resource cost now colored in red when not enough resource
[*] TAA set as default anti-aliasing method
[*] tower aggro sound is now higher pitched
[*] lobby invite list now automatically scrolls down

[*] moved scrolls into a collapsable tab in the shop
[*] added a mechanics-bar for neri passive
[*] various spell VFX and SFX have been improved for dandra, kaal, siko, aegion, lodwig, rhonheim
[*] new attack animation for Repentance R
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed myr spawning too many skeletons
[*] fixed tiki's not working
[*] fixed lana's passive bar not being displayed correctly
[*] fixed omnu terror buff vfx
[*] fixed broken waan sigil vfx
[*] fixed tower buffs overlapping health bar
[*] fixed buttons sometimes taking keyboard focus
[*] fixed buffs sometimes hiding player names
[*] fixed namuneth F and rak P not working after alignment removal
[*] fixed coagulants proccing while dead
[*] fixed an issue with vision calculations related to units in walls
[*] fixed material/mesh override system removing skins when polymorphed
[*] fixed game time dilation not properly working on buffs on health bars
[*] fixed a replay crash
[*] fixed chat message sound when pinging
[*] fixed required-item counter missing in shop for e.g black shards
[*] fixed siko W going on cd when interrupted
[*] fixed siko W being able to double snare
[*] fixed energizing potions not always restoring the full amount
[*] fixed hydra buff on nexus VFX looking weird
[*] fixed 3v3 map lighting
[*] fixed a problem with unique buffs removing themselves instead of refreshing
[*] fixed decaying shields removing all shields with infinite duration
[*] fixed truesight effects not properly respecting walls
[*] fixed bugged out settings panel when clicking on sticker in inventory
[*] fixed recommended items not properly updating when buying boots
[*] fixed bots getting stuck in base when minions are pushed up to their nexus
[*] fixed self-casts randomly rotating your character
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.13
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]New retainer: Xelv, Herald of Ruin - Assassin[/p][/*][*][p]buffs no longer have an alignment[/p][/*][*][p]buffs now have an animated marker to show if they are dispelable[/p][/*][*][p]dispels will remove all dispelable buffs/debuffs from a target[/p][/*][*][p]different types of buffs are now displayed in different ways on the health bar[/p][/*][*][p]less important buffs are only shown in the target or player panel[/p][/*][*][p]highly important buffs (e.g myr E, infernal wish) are shown as big icons to the right[/p][/*][*][p]stacking mechanics that build up to an effect (e.g dandra Q snare) now display a bar filling up their charges[/p][/*][*][p]character mechanic buffs (e.g al-rahim P, shizu P) are now displayed as special bars under your resource bar[/p][/*][*][p]the CC display was consolidated, now only showing one bar for the longest lasting most disabling CC [/p][/*][/list][h2]Character changes[/h2][list][*][p]Grob: P now charges up when spending rage instead, Q now instantly bounces to two/all nearby targets[/p][/*][*][p]Emonia: W charm removed, better scaling, lower cooldowns, %MS on Q, improved resource management[/p][/*][*][p]Peipei: Q now heals the full healing on impact, P can be triggered by healing or puddles[/p][/*][*][p]Krieg: R1 casts faster, R2 removed. F now deals damage when passing through enemies. Passive now stacks bleed and heals you, resets you R1 cooldown and grants resistances when fully stacked[/p][/*][*][p]Khoru: R deals current/missing % bonus damage based on stack count. W1 slows enemies, W2 casts a blizzard stacking slows, snares on full stacks[/p][/*][*][p]Golrok: R now shields nearby allies, instead of F[/p][/*][*][p]Dandra: W now also grants a shield, recasting the ability resets the shield[/p][/*][*][p]Prideseeker: P now charges on AA, when fully charged next R will reset cd, F will knock up or AA will stab in a line[/p][/*][*][p]Jabari: R targeted, cooldown reduced by collecting daggers. F now casts small daggers, F cooldown reduced when fully stacking passive[/p][/*][*][p]spells that can be charged like helentris R now update their target when letting go of the key[/p][/*][*][p]after losing vision of an enemy, you now follow them and restart your last action when regaining vision[/p][/*][*][p]buffs and shields now properly grant you assists[/p][/*][*][p]repentance F can now be cancelled by the player[/p][/*][*][p]repentance passive now triggers on jungle camps[/p][/*][*][p]tayji charm now has a brief cooldown per target[/p][/*][*][p]wavebinder R now longer allows turning, but fires faster
 [/p][/*][/list][h2]Visuals, UI, Sound[/h2][list][*][p]a new setting for sharper graphics has been added (on by default)[/p][/*][*][p]can now buy in shop with doubleclick on items[/p][/*][*][p]added a role filter to game setup[/p][/*][*][p]damage numbers now properly work with partially shielded attacks[/p][/*][*][p]damage numbers now show damage absorbed when shielding an ally[/p][/*][*][p]the talenteditor now shows animations indicating why you can't skill a talent[/p][/*][*][p]various items that were missing a sound effect now have one[/p][/*][*][p]kaal vfx and sfx improvements[/p][/*][*][p]lobby inventory screen entries resized[/p][/*][*][p]adaptive damage now shows the current damage type in tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]helentris model is no longer a placeholder[/p][/*][*][p]out-of-vision units like destructable rocks now hide their health bar[/p][/*][*][p]attack range is now displayed in the stats panel
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]fixed spells targeted out of range not working properly[/p][/*][*][p]fixed allies not being targetable[/p][/*][*][p]fixed post game screen getting stuck in loading[/p][/*][*][p]fixed paindrinker not working[/p][/*][*][p]fixed kingslayer not working[/p][/*][*][p]fixed channel spells being accidentally cancleable[/p][/*][*][p]fixed being able to cast spells while game is paused[/p][/*][*][p]fixed myr skeletons doing more damage than intended[/p][/*][*][p]fixed winged boots not working towards clones[/p][/*][*][p]fixed shizu f teleporting to the same location repeatedly[/p][/*][*][p]fixed qel f arrows spawning too far apart[/p][/*][*][p]fixed post game screen bugging out when leaving it too early[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some spells being castable while being knocked back[/p][/*][*][p]fixed scoreboard tooltips not being hidden when scoreboard hides[/p][/*][*][p]fixed vissra poisons not applying the correct ccs[/p][/*][*][p]fixed jabari bounceoff vfx[/p][/*][*][p]fixed silence vfx not showing for first 0.6 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]fixed tayji eye vfx not fading out corretcly[/p][/*][*][p]fixed healthbar ticks being sometimes inconsistantly spaced[/p][/*][*][p]fixed items not properly updating in target panel

notes.title: Closed Alpha Test 2.12
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]new vessel: Repentance [Bruiser, Spin2Win]
[*]new feature: destructable rocks (they block pathing and vision, can be destroyed and respawn)
[*]jungle pots and destructable rocks are now permanently visible, but appear "frozen" while out of vision
[*]clones and hero summons now automatically attack nearby enemies when no command is given
[*]roots no longer prevent knockbacks
[*]bag items now share cooldown
[*]you can now buffer actions that are not valid at the time of the keypress
[*]dandra E now grows in stages
[*]debilitation talent now increases damage taken
[*]minion XP reward greatly reduced
[*]dragon and hydra are weaker in the early game
[*]dragon respawns sooner
[*]team objectives give more global gold
[*]grimoire is cheaper, no longer gives stats
[*]anti-heal items are slightly cheaper
[*]worldender is now a crit item
[*]bandage/healthpot nerfs, tower regen buffed
[*]master magicians mantle and branch of the world tree have swapped passives
[/list]

[h2]Visuals, UI, Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*]lighting was updated on 3v3 / 1v1 maps
[*]added cc time to death recap
[*]helentris F animation updated
[*]added ebb and flow damage counter
[*]added an error popup when trying to buy currency with the steam overlay disabled
[*]added a rakzuul passive vfx
[*]chat no longer fades when scrolled up
[*]added siko voicelines
[*]various items have new or updated sounds, more to follow
[*]adjusted tags for all retainers/vessels
[*]experimental: shop icons are slightly bigger again [feedback welcome]
[*]new VFX for debilitation and windchaser scroll
[*]helentris model now has a proper texture
[/list]

[h2]Technical[/h2]
[list]
[*]auto self cast is now the default option (for new players)
[*]added cheat commands to start and stop jungle spawning
[*]added new voiceline trigger for assists, vessel picks and buying item with specific stats
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]fixed all missing buff and spell tooltips and many missing icons
[*]fixed edge of consciousness not updating correctly when rezzed
[*]fixed omnu invincibility issue
[*]fixed not being able to cast spells without a target when using smartcast with indicators
[*]fixed enemy/friendly kill counter order on scoreboard/header
[*]fixed shift-enter all chat not working after game end
[*]fixed some spell animations getting canceled early
[*]fixed some spells not showing up in the info center
[*]fixed regeneration/healing flags not properly applied for all spells/buffs
[*]fixed emonia W not generating energy
[*]fixed attackmove and attack-when-idle not attacking nearby jungle monsters on some weapons
[*]fixed jungle monsters getting stuck in a state of permanent resetting, regenerating constantly
[*]fixed jungle monsters resetting when killing their target, instead of attack their next target
[*]fixed shutdown announcer messages not showing the killer
[*]fixed various on-hit effects unintendedly (not) triggering when the target is killed by the basic attack (paindrinker, voltez p etc)
[*]fixed unit stats not instantly updating when a buff is forcefully removed
[*]fixed some buff tooltips not working
[*]fixed basic attack tooltips showing "cooldown"
[*]fixed peipei laugh voicelines
[*]fixed resource cost on abilities multiplying on client
[*]fixed spells with multiple charges not visually disabled when no charges ready
[*]fixed paused games never getting abandoned
[*]fixed not getting xp for kills when dead
[*]fixed drag scroll getting stuck sometimes
[*]fixed all charge spells getting longer instead of shorter cooldowns per level
[*]fixed some issues with tooltips and unique spell tags and cooldown groups
[*]fixed being able to use instant actions during dashes
[*]fixed charge spells not allowing you to buffer other spells
[*]fixed getting stuck in a black screen if the server refuses a connection, now shows a reconnect popup
[*]fixed multiple players on the same network being unable to connect
[*]fixed an issue with the waiting for stats panel not getting removed
[*]fixed nerumian mendian vfx
[*]fixed dashing against a wall not playing the animation
[*]fixed a material issue that caused several problems, like invisible omnu or texture glitch after taking gates while poly'd
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha 2.9
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] New Retainer (WIP): Siko, Eye of the Isles ["ADC"]
[*] Krieg R1 / R2 have switched places
[*] Shutdown bounty is now pingable
[*] Added a grace period after the nexus dies before the game is closed to allow chatting
[*] Jungle buffs now spawn faster, and shrine activations are cheaper
[*] "Bag" consumables are now free, but you can carry less of them
[*] All vessels spells on rage retainers now cost a baseline of 25
[/list]

[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain spells like teleport and recall now show on the minimap
[*] Health bars and other UI elements now work better on 4k monitors
[*] Added an option to scale health bars
[*] Player talents are now visible on the scoreboard and post game screen/match history
[*] Item and talent statistics are now visible in the post game screen/match history
[*] New UI background for the score display (topright), give some feedback how you like the style!
[*] Units are now clearly highlighted if they enter a bush, or are about to be rectangle-selected
[/list]

notes.title: Support Update
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]lana rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] no more hot/dot, instead basic attacks against enemies charge a buff, increasing your next AA healing
[*] R now embeds light in the target, healing or damaging them on your next AA and bouncing the light
[*] F now channels multiple flashes of light in the target location, healing and dispelling allies, blinding enemies
[/list]
  
[h3]dandra rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Q is now the old E, rooting enemies if they are hit multiple times
[*] W no longer heals
[*] E creates a large garden of thorns, running over them will heal allies and bleed+root enemies
[/list]

[h3]peipei update[/h3]
[list]
[*] W can now cast at allies directly (unit target) or in a direction, ignoring allies and knocking up the first enemy hit
[*] E now instantly polymorphs the target, and polymorphs nearby enemies when it expires
[/list]

[h3]tayji rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] R once again manually spawns eyes, they will charm nearby enemies
[*] Can be sacrificed to shield allies and grant on-hit damage
[*] F is now a long-range AOE shield+buff for allies and reveals enemies
[/list]

[h3]voltez update[/h3]
[list]
[*] P no longer paralyzes, instead ability damage marks enemies and AAs against a marked target will zap all marked enemies
[*] R now longer charges while casting, instead it is reactived to deal damage after landing. it charges up while on the ground to deal extra damage and paralyze.
[/list]

[h3]alrahim rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] P now charges up by dealing damage, granting you a shield and damaging fire storm
[*] R now fires a big pillar in front of you for extra damage, and three smallers ones that knock back
[*] W now grants instances of CC immunity while channeling
[*] E can now be casted multiple times, sending phoenix fire forwards that damages enemies and dispels allies
[/list]

[h3]uzai update[/h3]
[list]
[*] P grants a strong burst of attackspeed when something you control dies
[*] R can now be bounced in a straight line, and leaves behind a zones in which enemies take extra damage from your AAs
[*] F will now throw the grabbed target in front of you after it has been dragged to you (barrel version works as before)
[/list]

[h3]qel passive update[/h3]
[list]
[*] pushing enemies damages them
[*] pushing allies now grants them bonus damage on their next AA
[/list]
  
[h3]synestra update[/h3]
[list]
[*] spells now switch to stealth version no matter the reason for the invisibility
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] removed many unintended instance of rage generation
[*] controlled items like scythe now prioritize retainers
[*] towers now reset their attack timer when switching targets, making lasthitting slightly easier
[*] rudra now only generates critical charges from the primary attack, but if the primary attack crits so do all bounces
[/list]


[h2]Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] added "sticker" system, overhead display
[*] shards are now team wide, shrines require all shards at once to activate
[*] blindpick with bans has been added as a gamemode
[*] health restore spells and effects are now split between healing/regeneration categories, fixing various unintended interactions
[*] on-hit effects now only apply to the primary target for various spells
[*] rate limits have been introduced for pings, emotes, chat and stickers
[*] added damage stats for everburn, ignition wand, goggles, hortax and thundercore
[/list]


[h2]Visuals and Tech[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dreamfall Grove lighting has been updated [WIP]
[*] Dreamfall Grove music updated
[*] added cloud shadows to Dreamfall Grove
[*] loading screen backgrounds updated
[*] full item shop UI now available in the info center
[*] added a mana reg indicator to the UI
[*] new icon for trainees knife
[/list]


[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed cc from allies flashing your screen
[*] fixed omnu ult teleport cd missing
[*] fixed ampwrecker and it now works on all nearby towers
[*] fixed loading screen text sometimes overlapping players
[*] fixed buffs overlapping with skillup buttons

[*] fixed cannon minion spawning on 2nd wave at the start of the game
[*] fixed jungle camps not losing patience when their target turns invisible
[*] fixed vessel ability tooltips displaying wrong cost
[*] fixed "attack when idle" sometimes not working
[*] fixed boss monsters being permanently revealed after attacking them once
[*] fixed various issues with the "/switch" cheat, like UI elements not resettings and not respawning

notes.title: Economy and Energy Update

[list]
[*]  Now uses Energy instead of Mana
[*]  Q builds movementspeed when able to use continuously
